title: viola sylvestris var. rupestris
intro: Viola sylvestris var. rupestris, commonly known as Alpine Viola, is a plant species within the violet genus that is typically found growing in mountainous regions and rocky areas. Alpine Viola is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety and insomnia, due to its calming and sedative effects. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Alpine Viola include reducing stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality, making it a popular natural remedy for individuals seeking a holistic approach to health and wellness.
